name: workspace
//: The Rust line-coverage floor, enforced once over every crate's run (the journeys spawn the instrumented binary, so the floor counts what they cover), and the supply chain. Depends on every crate so a change to any of them selects it.

options.command: bun run biome format nx.json biome.json package.json .claude workspace crates sdks tools npm
bun run biome format --write nx.json biome.json package.json .claude workspace crates sdks tools npm
